changes: Use repository-owned normalized technical/CJK encoder
Require all query terms instead of silent partial suggestions
Rank page titles, chapter headings, then body matches
Deduplicate chapter destinations and retain page-only results
Validate HTTP status and data shape before building indexes
Build indexes in cooperatively scheduled chapter-sized batches to keep the dialog responsive
Preserve native Home/End text editing in the input
Show loading and connection failure separately from no results
Clear stale options while a query is pending and reject stale completions
Normalize query highlighting and bound input length
Deactivate stale options immediately when the input is cleared
Highlight each normalized query term independently
Focus and select synchronously on open so a deferred frame cannot steal result focus
Ignore stale native close events when the search dialog has already reopened
Update the trigger accessible name when the visible shortcut changes to the Mac command key
Derive chapter option names from their rendered title and excerpt instead of a separately concatenated label
Remove unsupported redundant naming from generic breadcrumb containers
Allow global search shortcuts from buttons while preserving input, select, textarea and contenteditable editing
Keep each chapter option associated with its article title through aria-describedby
Mark the 404 page noindex while retaining the shared head, theme, navigation and search assets
Include the shared canonical blog and learning path in both language search indexes
Retain language-specific pages, exclusion rules and glossary handling
Recheck code overflow after font loading, text sizing and disclosure changes with batched measurements
Keep the pending copy control focusable and suppress duplicate activation without native disabling
Offer exact manual selection on failure only when the reader has retained focus and selection
Retain manual-selection focus on short blocks until blur, then remove the temporary tab stop
Use the existing theme hook to load a repository-owned progressive native image viewer
Retain the archived vendor source and license without loading Medium Zoom at runtime
Expose Control+k and Meta+k through aria-keyshortcuts
Include the visible search label and shortcut hint in the accessible name
Include the visible current-language label in the accessible name while keeping icon-only triggers concise
Include the visible ESC text in the close control name and expose the Escape shortcut
Add an initial display-formula tab stop for keyboard scrolling before or without page scripts
Retain the original KaTeX/MathML output, error handling and MathJax fallback

maintenance: When upgrading the theme, compare these overrides with their upstream versions and rerun site assets, image fixtures, the search unit test and the full browser regressions.
scope: Upstream-derived overrides introduced in the 2026-10-27 review; earlier repository overrides remain documented in their original reviews.
